found_by: Five Codex review threads on #778 at ee01dd127 (four P1, one P2), each answered by a rule below before any R1 or R2b execution.
policy: Earlier files stay byte-identical; D5 adds constraints and governs where it conflicts with them. R2a's own rules are unchanged except D5.1's fetch path.

deviations.finding: Arm A's revision 99dfec7c is not reachable from main
deviations.rule: Arm A's refetch.py is taken from 99dfec7cf6bdd2bc49f0099206ed84fc1d88ebb1, fetched with `git fetch origin refs/pull/485/head` (GitHub keeps pull-request refs) or from origin/claude/mover-asof-recollection-20260929. Before any command, the blob's sha256 must equal plan.json R2a.arms.A_exact.refetch_sha256 (fc6d5415...). Its imports and plan.json are byte-identical between 99dfec7c and the base commit (verified when this file was written). If the blob cannot be obtained with that hash, R2a is NOT_STARTED (30).

deviations.finding: R2b's dimensions need inputs beyond Arm A's outputs
deviations.rule: R2b reads Arm A's results.json and labels.json plus the hash-pinned retained E2 inputs (the 7 input files of plan.json R2a.input_sha256 and the package zip a0b0aabf...), each checked against its pin first; no other data. Year comes from the event date; price and dollar-volume buckets from the retained snapshot bars of the prior session; session timing from the package's extended-hours dataset; catalyst tag from the package's category. A value these inputs do not give is counted in unknown, never fetched.

deviations.finding: Event-scope fixtures came from private data while R1 was repository-only
deviations.clarifies: The P2 of the cross-family D5 check at 0fa685b03, which the R1 lane also raised: bind exactly two records by path and sha256 and open no other retained or private file.
deviations.rule: Besides repository files at the base commit, R1 opens exactly the two records below, each only after its sha256 equals the pin; a missing record or a different hash means R1 is NOT_STARTED (30) and runs nothing. R1 opens no other retained or private file: none of the retained E2 run's other files (its e2/ outputs, snapshots, request log, control or fetch status), no other member of the package zip (the alias map included) and no copy in an R2a job. The retained E2 run only says where the package zip is kept; it permits no read. The D4.1 event fixtures stand as pinned, and R1's extractor derives them from these two records and the repository files D4.1 cites, using only the fields named per record.

records.path_root: RUN, the retained 2026-09-29 mover-coverage-asof E2 run directory asof-20260929 in the private research state outside git (mover-coverage-asof/README.md:48); the same locator the R2a job's D3 check used
records.fields: The member's Date column only, compared as written: its row count and its minimum and maximum give the extreme-gainer fixture (957; 2021-01-06..2026-09-22), and the count of rows dated 2021-01-04..2025-12-31 inclusive gives the E2 fixture's 715, the same filter as mover-coverage-asof/refetch.py:68 and :924. No other member or column is read.

E2.package_events_in_window only, which must equal the count derived from the zip member (715). The E2 fixture's date range is the window that mover-coverage-asof/README.md:24 states, a repository source.

deviations.finding: R2b's counts were not recomputed from the pinned artifacts
deviations.rule: R2b's counts come from a deterministic, stdlib-only profile builder over D5.2's inputs. That builder is added, read cross-family and pinned by a further dated deviation before R2b starts. R2b's acceptance adds: two builder runs produce byte-identical output, and the published profile equals that output; any difference is REJECTED_RECONCILIATION (31). validate_r2b.py stays the schema and reconciliation check.

deviations.finding: The validator accepted floating-point population counts
deviations.rule: validate_r2b.py r2 rejects non-integer populations and counts (type int only, never float or bool); its self-test grows to 8 cases. It replaces D4.3's pin.
Registry: deviations-20261006-3.json and validate_r2b.py r2 are registered in the branch's last commit.

execution_gate: R1 waits for the command center's ACK of this file, which governs its inputs. R2a may continue (D5.1 only names its fetch path). R2b waits for an accepted R1, a reproduced R2a and the pinned profile builder of D5.4.
